Mr. Mehboob Ali Laghari advocate for the petitioner.
body: 4. Through this Constitutional Petition, the petitioner has prayed that official respondents may be restrained from causing harassment at the behest of private respondents. Learned Additional A.G, present in court in other matters, waived notice of instant petition and submits that official respondents shall act strictly in accordance with law. In view of above situation, instant petition is disposed of with direction to the official respondents not to cause any sort of harassment to the petitioner and to act strictly in accordance with law.
Copy of this order be sent to the S.S.P concerned for information and compliance.
